question: Which of the following Central Nodal Agencies has been identified to channelise subsidy for PMAY (Urban)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** NHB**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• . The National Housing Bank (NHB) is the Central Nodal Agency responsible for channelling subsidies for the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) (PMAY-U).
 
• It plays a crucial role in implementing the scheme by providing financial assistance to various stakeholders, including state governments, urban local bodies, and housing finance companies.
